children: Hong Kong’s Securities and Futures Commission has issued consultation conclusions proposing amendments to two ordinances to restrict unauthorized entities from using certain terms that could lead the public to believe they are regulated by the SFC or affiliated with an exchange, clearing house, or virtual asset trading platform. According to Odaily, the proposed restrictions cover terms such as “crypto” and “exchange.”

title: Hong Kong SFC Plans to Restrict Unauthorized Use of “Crypto” and “Exchange” Terms
